description: A DSP48E1 with USE_SIMD "FOUR12" writes both SIMD features
exercises: the DSP48E1 USE_SIMD_FOUR12 and USE_SIMD_FOUR12_TWO24 features in the FASM writer
why: FOUR12 splits the post-adder into four 12-bit lanes. Vivado sets two bits for it, USE_SIMD_FOUR12 and USE_SIMD_FOUR12_TWO24 (the second alone is TWO24). Release 2026-10-14 writes only the first, a combination Vivado writes for no SIMD mode, and the bitstream assembles without complaint. openXC7/nextpnr#105 writes both.
